More room to rent: 161 homes planned in Southeast Austin.

Yardly Easton Park is planned for 9000 Skytex Drive. Groundbreak’s November 13 report puts the Taylor Morrison project at 161 rental homes. The developer’s project page lists three- and four-bedroom, two-story layouts with private backyards and says the community is in the planning stages.

The Austin housing connection: this would add larger rental layouts with outdoor space in Southeast Austin, expanding the types of homes renters can choose from. These 161 homes belong in the future supply pipeline—not today’s available inventory. The project’s eventual rents and delivery will determine its effect on local rental choices.

Sources: Groundbreak, November 13, 2026; Taylor Morrison project page, checked November 16, 2026.
